purpose: Merge complementary source intentions into CBE execution; not source-count parity or completion credit

source_witnesses.intent: Rear-first requests create room before the blocked predecessor moves; prefer longer smooth legs and stop backing when front traffic departs.
redesign: forced pushes become native finite movement
renewable yield clocks become original finite episode deadline
owner-local consent and exact command ownership replace shared request flags

source_witnesses.intent: Keep a busy actor pursuing the same nearby hide destination instead of constantly reissuing movement.
retain: native movement continuity under unchanged intent
source_witnesses.limits: This is a continuity principle, not a source implementation of vehicle queues or complete squad CQB.

ordinary_following.implemented: Follower spacing/catch-up, bounded acceleration and retention of an unchanged native goal on aligned straight legs.
ordinary_following.open: Mixed tracked/wheeled physical smoothness and gap convergence remain unverified.

room_making.implemented: Bounded dependency discovery, authenticated consent and retirement; shared rear body observation.
room_making.missing: No native queue executor, held-command receipts, settled READY, rear-first physical room, crossing or handback.

ownership_conflict.finding: A generic Cortex movement lease makes DrivingOperationStep cancel the parent driving brain; parent finish then releases its queue consent.
ownership_conflict.required: A queue phase belongs to each existing parent driving brain. All other vehicle/group writers yield to its exact episode; no generic takeover of that same parent.

execution_contract.requirement: All actual owners validate the same agreed token, original context and expiry before accepting a queue child. No participant is commanded merely because the initiator received AGREED.

Each owner captures its own applied speed/native command receipts, prevents ordinary traffic/recovery/passing writes for the same participant, and acknowledges only applied controls. Unrelated vehicles in a shared group must not be silently commandeered.
Receipt-bound finite linear and angular rest plus a dwell observation; consent and requested zero speed are not evidence of stopped motion. Pose and held commands must remain current.

Only the current leaf may issue native reverse after fresh whole-body rear clearance; monitor native command, original damage minima, current hull/heading and deadline. No forced velocity, teleport, collision suppression or arbitrary point completion.
A predecessor moves only after measured hull clearance exists. A promise, elapsed timer or prior arrival flag cannot substitute for current space. Re-check vehicles returning into cleared space.
Select and validate an actually usable passing corridor; rear room alone does not prove two opposing hulls can pass. Keep yielding participants held until measured whole-hull crossing clears them.

Return each original route/cap only while exact owned commands and current parent/crew/epoch still match. New Zeus/native/service/external orders win immediately. Every expiry/cancellation path releases only this episode.

balance_and_cost: No omniscient hostile knowledge or unilateral orders to unrelated owners.
Existing original consent expiry remains binding; do not silently extend30seconds into the80second traffic retry journal. A larger execution budget would require an explicitly agreed new protocol.
At most4 participants; bounded geometry, finite retries and parent scheduler callbacks rather than a permanent queue controller.
Root success is insufficient: every participant must hand back and physically resume.
No parity or performance-budget acceptance until actual normal and separate HC cases pass.
acceptance_cases: two opposing vehicles with open rear room
new individual/native/Zeus order in every movement phase
owner migration and disconnect in separate HC batch
mixed wheeled/tracked stop-start and measured cost
